summary: Backend learning loop: plan wiring, teach sequencing, quiz feedback actions, preferences, session delete, mastery reset, warden fixes M-1..M-4
notes: Warden fixes: M-1 reconciled T2.json (status done, test-suite repair files added to modified, line_counts filled, focus-param note). M-2 regrade gate: re-answer allowed only while last outcome is incorrect/idk; a correct-to-incorrect flip raises ValueError('question already answered correctly') and never adds evidence; identical replay is idempotent. M-3 PHASES canonicalized in app/services/sessions.py (set_phase validates against it); stale module docstring in sessions.py removed; CHECK_EVERY_NODES moved to teach.py; remediate is now a normal state (hint/reveal/skip/continue exits). M-4 structured.py request_questions/request_plan now raise ProviderError (via provider_error_from_text) when LLMClient.complete_json returns (None, err); ModelOutputError is raised only when the model returned but the output was unusable; same distinction in teach.hint. Race fix: answer_quiz claims the row with an UPDATE WHERE status IS ? AND outcome IS ? gate; a lost race re-reads and replays the stored result so concurrent identical submissions cannot double-count evidence. Corrupt options_json -> clean ValueError; pending questions ordered by created_at,rowid. QuizAnswerResult (dead model) removed. Session delete cancels in-flight generation before DELETE (FK cascade). tests/test_files.py got a 20ms sleep in the recency test to de-flake an equal-millisecond updated_at race observed once under full-suite load (same class of test-suite repair warden accepted in T2). M-2 interpretation: idk is treated as a retryable outcome (a check answered idk must be re-answerable after remediation).
